ns2:section.sectionText: In this service-learning course, students work in teams to create and execute lessons for underrepresented youth in local STEM education outreach programs and produce a collaborative social action arts event to raise public awareness of issues related to social justice and STEM education. The course includes exploration of topics related to social justice and engineering, civic engagement, racial and ethnic identity development, stereotype threat and performance, structural oppression, inequalities in schooling, and the impact of racial and ethnic disparities in STEM education. Restricted to students in the Engineering for Social Justice Scholars Program. Students must apply and interview for the program, which includes a two-semester commitment. For inquiries, contact werpetin@illinois.edu. Honors credit; open to all students across campus (NOT restricted to James Scholars or Campus Honors students).
